plans.title: Prove text bounds against the real renderer

assertions: Build an independent Skia pixel/bounds probe for brand-font fixtures: fractional sizes, kerning, word wrapping, rotation and deliberately clipped text. Pair each failure with a valid control; record unsupported shaping. Do not import Pillow wrapping helpers as the oracle. A BASIC hash match or font-byte match alone is insufficient.
